title: Unveiling the Tapestry of Automated Essay Scoring: A Comprehensive Investigation of Accuracy, Fairness, and Generalizability

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating predictive fairness of automated essay scoring models by calculating Overall Score Accuracy (OSA), Overall Score Difference (OSD), Conditional Score Difference (CSD), and Mean Absolute Error Difference (MAED) between economically advantaged and disadvantaged students.
Evaluating predictive fairness of automated essay scoring models by calculating scoring errors and differences (OSA, OSD, CSD, MAED) between male and female students.
Evaluating predictive fairness of automated essay scoring models by calculating scoring errors and differences (OSA, OSD, CSD, MAED) between students with and without disabilities.

Evaluating predictive fairness of automated essay scoring models by calculating scoring errors and differences (OSA, OSD, CSD, MAED) between native English speakers and non-native English speakers (English Language Learners).
Evaluating predictive fairness of automated essay scoring models by calculating scoring errors and differences (OSA, OSD, CSD, MAED) between White students and Non-White students.
